title: The parser finds an empty comment that is abruptly closed by a U+003E (>) code point (i.e., <!--> or <!--->).
summary: The parser behaves as if the comment is closed correctly.

title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point in the DOCTYPE public identifier (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "foo>).
summary: In such a case, if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, the parser sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a U+003E (>) code point in the DOCTYPE system identifier (e.g., <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01//EN" "foo>).
summary: In such a case, if the DOCTYPE is correctly placed as a document preamble, the parser sets the Document to quirks mode.

title: The parser finds a numeric character reference that doesn't contain any digits (e.g., &#qux;).
summary: In this case the parser doesn't resolve the character reference.
